top_comments.author: Jakepawl
top_comments.body: Usage has been cut in half and dumbed down. Inside info is they are using their servers to prioritize training for sonnet 4.5 to launch at the same time as xAI dedicated coding model. xAI coding logic is very close to sonnet 4 and has anthropic scrambling. xAI sucks at making designs but codes really well.

top_comments.author: pfuhrmann
top_comments.body:
And we are not already paying enough for them to do that on the budget while keeping the service running?

This sounds slightly ridiculous. We pay $200 p/m to get overloaded messages, for them to train bigger models, so that we can pay $400 per month for those new models.

top_comments.body:
Same issue on the $200/m Max.
It's frustrating that it doesn't show on their status page.
